$comment: Supply-chain record for third-party provider jars layered into the OSF Keycloak image (Dockerfile). `keycloak` is the base-image version these pins were reviewed against; scripts/check-keycloak-lockstep.mjs fails when the Dockerfile or pom.xml moves Keycloak without this record being updated, or when a Dockerfile pin disagrees with the record. Bumping Keycloak therefore forces a review of every provider's compatibility statement and checksum in the same change.

apple-identity-provider.compatibilityNote: Extension releases >= 1.17.0 target Keycloak >= 26.5.0. Reviewed against Keycloak 26.5.3 on 2026-09-03.
